# Table

Standard table component for displaying tabular data, built from the shared `_Table` parts (`TableRow`, `TableCell`, `TableMessageRow`, `TableSummaryRow`, `TableFooter`). The feel: hairline horizontal dividers, no outer frame, a quiet header over a stronger rule, single-line cells that end in an ellipsis with a tooltip, no zebra. Rows are 32, 40 or 48 tall (`size`). `StaticTable` is this table for a fixed grid people read.

Also asked as: rows and columns, grid.

**Import:** `import { Table } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/Table/Table.jsx`

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/Table/StaticTable.mdx`

## Usage

Use `StaticTable` for a grid people only read: a record, a summary, a rate
card. A table people sort, filter, select or page is a Dynamic table.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Title the one column that names the record. | Bold several columns. |
| Right-align numbers and keep units in the header. | Left-align numbers or repeat units in every cell. |
| Keep a cell to one line; let long text truncate with its tooltip. | Wrap every cell. |
| Use a dash for an empty cell. | Leave a cell blank or write "N/A". |

## Best practices

### Right-align numbers. {#right-align-numbers}

Do: Numbers align by their digits, so the amounts line up.
Don't: Left-aligned numbers do not line up.

### Name the record in one column. {#name-the-record-in-one-column}

Do: `titleColumn` marks the one column that names the row.
Don't: Emphasis on every cell, so nothing stands out.

### Keep a cell to one line. {#keep-a-cell-to-one-line}

Do: Long text truncates with an ellipsis and shows in full in a tooltip.
Don't: Every cell wrapped, so rows grow uneven.

## Accessibility

- **It is a real table.** Headers are `th` in a `thead`, so a screen reader announces the column for each cell.
- **Rows are not controls.** Nothing in a Static table takes focus; a table people interact with is a Dynamic table.
- **State is not color alone.** A selected row sets `aria-selected`, a disabled row `aria-disabled`.
- **Truncated text keeps its full value.** A cell that ends in an ellipsis shows the whole text in a tooltip.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | The `id` of the `table` element. The wrapper takes `{id}-wrapper`. |
| `headers` | arrayOf | `[]` | The column headers. A string is the header text; an object adds `width`, `align`, `className` and `style` to `text`. |
| `rows` | enum | `[]` | The body rows, each an array of cells. A cell is a node, or an object with `content` plus `align`, `emphasis`, `overflow`, `secondary`, `leading`, `state`, `loading`, `className`, `colSpan` or `style`. |
| `striped` | bool | `false` | Shades alternate rows. |
| `hover` | bool | `true` | Highlights a row on hover. On by default. |
| `bordered` | bool | `false` | Draws a frame around the table and lines between columns. Shorthand for `frame="framed"` plus `verticalLines`. |
| `verticalLines` | bool | `false` | Draws lines between columns. |
| `frame` | enum | `'plain'` | `plain` (default) draws no outer frame; `framed` draws a border around the table. |
| `size` | enum | — | Row height in px: 32 for dense tables, 40 (default) or 48 for roomy ones. |
| `titleColumn` | number | — | The index of the column drawn in the title emphasis, for the row's main label. |
| `rowStates` | enum | — | A state per row, by index: `rest`, `highlighted`, `selected` or `disabled`. |
| `summary` | arrayOf | — | Cells for a summary row at the bottom of the table, one per column, such as totals. |
| `emptyState` | node | — | Content shown in a single row spanning all columns when `rows` is empty. |
| `footer` | node | — | Content drawn under the table inside its wrapper, such as pagination. |
| `onRowClick` | func | — | Called with the row index when a row is clicked. The row gets no button role or key handling, so put any keyboard action in a control inside a cell. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the `table` element beside the component's own. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline styles for the table's wrapper element. |

## Variants

**`frame`** — `plain` · `framed`

**`size`** — `32` · `40` · `48`

Anything not listed is not a valid value.

## Related

- For a table people sort, filter, select or page, use the Dynamic table.
- For records that nest, use the Tree table.
- For splitting a long result set across pages, use `Pagination`.
- For a status or a count inside a cell, use `StatusTag` or `CountTag`.

Same group: `Code` · `CodeBlock` · `Heading`
